entities.summary: Wang Lei is a Chinese chess player holding the title of Woman Grandmaster. She was in the FIDE Top 50 Women rating list from 2000 to 2003. Wang is a four-time Chinese women's champion. In 1996 she won the Women's World University Chess Championship in León, Spain.
